items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Helen asked me, “What state can I get married in without the consent of the parents?” ... So I asked the girls at the switchboard... Within an hour I heard that there was a rumor that George Avakian is crazy about this 17-year-old gorgeous Armenian

ctx.x: Oh yeah, the luckiest thing that ever happened to me, because she’s the most marvelous person I’ve ever known, in addition to being a magnificent musician and a magnificent wife. She’s even a magnificent cook. The fact that I was familiar with the general idea of certain phases of contemporary classical music made our marriage, I think, even better, because I began to know more

about straight classical music through Anahid. Now my favorite form of music is violin and piano sonatas, and string quartets, which is very pure music. That’s why I didn’t hesitate to suggest recording Cage’s music and Hovhaness’s music. Columbia didn’t want to do it, but I told Mr. Wallerstein my friend Moe Asch would do it on his little label.
